verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾਂ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਅਬਚਲੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਵਡੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: paatisaahaa(n) paatisaahu hai abachal raaj vaddee paatisaahee|

en.bdb: He (the Lord) is emperor of emperors whose rule is stable and kingdom greatly large.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਤਖਤੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਦਰਗਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: kevadd takhat vakhaaneeaai kevadd mahal kevadd dharagaahee|

en.bdb: How big are His throne, palace and the court.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਮੁਲਖੁ ਅਵਗਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: kevadd sifat salaaheeaai kevadd maal mulakh avagaahee|

en.bdb: How should He be eulogised and how could be known the expanse of His treasure and territory?

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਹੈ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਲਸਕਰ ਸੇਵ ਸਿਪਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: kevadd maan mahat hai kevadd lasakar sev sipaahee|

en.bdb: How great is His grandeur and magnificence and how many soldiers and armies are there in His service?

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: hukamai a(n)dhar sabh ko kevadd hukam na beparavaahee|

en.bdb: Everything is under His order is so much organised and powerful that no carelessness is there.
He asks none to arrange all this.
